The 2026 Samsung AC range features WindFree technology that spreads cool air without uncomfortable direct draughts, making it particularly useful for bedrooms and overnight cooling. Select models also offer AI Auto Cooling to adjust cooling settings automatically, SmartThings connectivity for smartphone control, and convertible modes to match changing cooling needs. For households running their AC for longer hours, choosing a higher-rated model could offer greater electricity savings over time.
